\vspace{-5em}

**Name:** ____________________________________________


1. Which statement about R and RStudio is correct?

[ ] RStudio is a replacement for R, so R does not need to be installed.

[ ] R is the programming language, and RStudio is an interface (IDE) for working with R.

[ ] RStudio can only be used through an online environment like Posit Cloud.

[ ] R and RStudio are two names for the same program.



\vspace{0.5em}

2. Which statement about running code from an R script file is correct?

[ ] You should not run code from an R script and should always type code directly into the console.

[ ] You cannot save an R script file.

[ ] You can highlight part of the code in an R script file and run only the highlighted portion.

[ ] All lines of code in an R script must be run together.


\vspace{0.5em}

3. If you don't have highlighted code in an R script file, what happens when you try to run code (by hitting Command + Enter on a Mac, or Ctrl + Enter on Windows)?

[ ] The current line of code where the cursor is located will be run.

[ ] Nothing will happen.

[ ] The entire script will be run.

[ ] An error message will be displayed.


\vspace{0.5em}

4. Which of the following is the correct code to calculate $\sqrt{2}$ in R?

[ ] sqrt(2)

[ ] sqrt: 2

[ ] sqrt of 2

[ ] R cannot calculate square roots.


\vspace{0.5em}

5. If you run `2+5` in R, what will be the output?

[ ] 7

[ ] 25

[ ] "2+5"

[ ] An error message will be displayed.
